summary.text: LANDHANDLERI TORPA AS is a private limited company registered in Nord-Torpa, founded 2021-06-02. Landhandleri Torpa AS driver butikkhandel med bredt vareutvalg med hovedvekt på nærings- og nytelsesmidler. Its main industry code is 47.110: non-specialised retail sale of predominately food, beverages or tobacco. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 28 619 026 NOK and the annual result was 1 051 850 NOK; operating income was up from 27 562 057 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 213 811 NOK in 2024 to 1 051 850 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 3 170 323 NOK in 2024 to 4 222 173 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 10 on 2026-01-14 to 12 on 2026-10-14. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-14 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
